decisions.briefing: Markets were mildly risk-on today (NASDAQ +0.9%, S&P 500 +0.7%). Among all candidates, only NWL and LOAR showed the full combination of bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge, so I'm deploying cash into both with high conviction while leaving one slot open for a stronger setup.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market indices posted modest gains today, with the NASDAQ up 0.9% and the S&P 500 up 0.7%, reflecting a mild risk-on tone rather than a sharp rally. No major catalyst headlines were available in today's feed to pin the move to a single event. The gains were broad enough to lift momentum names like NWL and LOAR, which showed confirmed volume and trend signals.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍溫和上揚,納斯達克指數上升0.9%,標普500指數上升0.7%,屬於溫和的風險偏好氛圍,而非大幅急升。今日資訊中未見明確的重大新聞事件可解釋此波動。升勢足以帶動NWL及LOAR等具動能的股票,其成交量及趨勢訊號均獲確認。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and trading volume — to all point the same direction before buying, instead of acting on just one signal. This reduces the chance of chasing a false breakout. Today, only two candidates out of dozens had all the signals lined up.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前,等待多個技術訊號(例如RSI、MACD、價格趨勢及成交量)同時指向同一方向,而不是只憑單一訊號行動。這樣可以減少追逐假突破的風險。今日在眾多候選股票中,只有兩隻股票的所有訊號同時出現。
